entity.remarks: The Secretary of State considers that there are reasonable grounds to suspect that Marat Arkadyevich KAMBOLOV is an involved person under the Russia (Sanctions) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 on the basis of the following grounds: 1. KAMBOLOV has obtained a benefit from the Government of Russia by working as a director (whether executive or non-executive), trustee, or other manager or equivalent, of the Kurchatov Institute between 2015 and 2025, which is carrying on business in the Russian Energy Sector. 2. KAMBOLOV has obtained a benefit from the Government of Russia by working as a director (whether executive or non-executive), trustee, or other manager or equivalent of the Kurchatov Institute between 2015 and 2025, which is Government of Russia-affiliated entity.

positions: Chairman of the Board of the “Movement of the First”
entity.remarks: The Secretary of State considers that there are reasonable grounds to suspect that Artur Valerevich ORLOV is an involved person under the Russia (Sanctions) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 on the grounds that he is or has been involved in destabilising Ukraine or undermining or threatening the territorial integrity, sovereignty or independence of Ukraine as a person who is responsible for, engages in, provides support for, or promotes policies or actions which destabilise Ukraine or undermine or threaten the territorial integrity, sovereignty or independence of Ukraine. Namely, engaging in, promoting, and providing support for the Government of Russia’s programme for the forced deportation and re-education of Ukrainian children.
